messages:
noah: Reminder: CedarSys kickoff tomorrow 9am PT. Need final success metrics and any legal/finance asks up front.
iris: CedarSys will supply anonymized chat logs (~8GB) + product FAQ doc. They requested scripted onboarding.
chloe: Use cases: 1) suggested resolutions for Tier2, 2) automated FAQ answerer for self-service widget.
pre-sales: Proposed success criteria:
 - Resolution suggestion accuracy >= 80% on 250 cases
 - FAQ answer retrieval precision >= 90%
 - Response time p95 < 400ms under test load
 - No sensitive data returned in 2k random queries
iris: Timeline they prefer is 10 business days. Week1: ingest + baseline, Week2: tuning + UAT.
noah: Pricing: they start hosted trial but want estimate for dedicated at 8k msgs/day. Finance needs expected token consumption per message.
billing-bot: Please provide average tokens per response and tokens per input. I'll create a draft cost model.
chloe: We'll target ~120 tokens output average and ~80 input. I'll pass these to billing.
sec-bot: Security SQ: https://sec.redwood.example/sq/19888. They asked for PII redaction and DSG compliance notes.
iris: Who owns SQ responses? @chloe?
chloe: I'll draft ops answers; legal will need to review data processing clauses.
pre-sales: Prompt examples for evaluation:
1) "Given the chat log, suggest top 3 next actions for the agent"
2) "Answer the FAQ question in <=40 words and include a documentation link if applicable"
3) "Return {issue_type, confidence_score} as json"
noah: Also include a requirement: fallback model must not degrade FAQ accuracy by more than 5% vs primary.
chloe: Noted. Let's finalize and I will post agenda + dial-in 15m before kickoff. Any other blockers?
pre-sales: Need an IP allowlist and role-based credentials for ingestion. Customer prefers KMS-managed keys for POC.
billing-bot: Also request billing contact and tentative PO details for post-POC.
noah: Great. Lock the scope in thread by 8am PT tomorrow.
iris: Copy. I'll upload data access instructions and the ingest script to the shared folder tonight.
